graph_metadata.description: Normalized graph: canonical ingredients + equipment nodes. Auto-merged near-duplicates.

nodes.name: Tropical Pumpkin Smoothie
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR SIX SERVINGS: 1. In blender, place the following: 8-oz spoodle pumpkin 6-oz spoodle banana 4-oz spoodle pineapple 1-oz spoodle honey 1 tsp cinnamon 1/4 tsp nutmeg 1/2 tsp ginger 1/2 cup oat milk 1/4 cup apple juice 2. Blend until smooth, 15-20 seconds. 3. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: Carot Cake Smoothie
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR Five 8-OZV SERVINGS: 1. In blender, place the following: 1 each banana 10-oz diced peeled carrot 2 Cups of ice 1/2 Teaspoon of ginger 1/2 teaspoon of ground cinnamon 16 oz. Almond Milk 1 Tbs. Honey 1/2 Cup Oats 2. Blend until smooth, 15-20 seconds. 3. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: Mixed Berry Cucumber Smoothie
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In food processor, combine basil, parsley, Parmesan, garlic, salt and pepper. Pulse until basil and parsley are finely chopped. Add lemon juice. 2. With processor running, slowly add oil in a thin, steady stream until mixture is creamy. 3. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe. 4. Whisk before using.

nodes.name: UVA Tropical Green Smoothie
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR 12 SERVING: 1. In blender, place the following: 3 each 4-oz spoodle pineapple 3 each 4-oz spoodle ice 3 each 4-oz spoodle kale 6-oz spoodle spinach 3 each 4-oz ladle almond milk 1-1/2 tsp ginger 3/4 tsp turmeric 2. Blend until smooth, 15 to 20 seconds. 3. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: Strawberry-Banana Smoothie
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR FOUR 8-OZV SERVINGS: 1. In blender, place the following: 2 each 6-oz spoodles banana 2 each 8-oz spoodles frozen strawberries 8-oz spoodle ice #8 scoop yogurt 4-oz ladle apple juice 2. Blend until smooth, 15-20 seconds. 3. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: Toasted Coconut
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 300 F. 2. On sheet pan(s), spread coconut in thin layer. 3. Bake, stirring once, until coconut is lightly toasted, 6 to 8 minutes. Cool. 4. Cover. Hold at room temperature for service or use as directed in recipe.
